question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **'place'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The tone of the passage is 'advisory and reflective'.
 
• The context requires a term that refers to the location or position where the stone remains stationary.
 
• 'Locality' and 'society' are broader than needed, while 'size' doesn't refer to a location at all.
 
• **'Place'** fits the context perfectly as it refers to a specific location or position, in this case where the stone remains lying.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***'place'.***

***The Passage is__ ***A stone that is constantly rolling cannot gather moss , while a stone that remains lying in one (1) __**place**__ will gather it after a time. In the same way, a man who is a rolling stone, who is constantly (2) ________ his occupations and pursuits, and does not settle (3) _______ long for any particular work, achieves little or no (4) _____ in life. One who is constantly chopping and changing will never become wealthy and get success in life. He will merely be dissipating his energies, and will get nowhere. As the proverb says , ‘He who hunts two hares, loses (5)________’. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **Best way to solve the Cloze test:**

 
 
• Before you begin filling in the blanks, always make sure to read the entire passage with its blanks. This will help you to grasp the overall tone of the text, which in turn can assist you in eliminating incorrect options.
